scope: Runtime select socket readiness and concurrent close policy; original DBMW regression

finding.trigger: A DBMW worker closes a listening socket while another thread is in select. Winsock wakes select with a stale ready count; the original guest then reads its already -1 socket descriptor and crashes at 0x08058634.
finding.policy: The runtime publishes INVALID_SOCKET before closesocket and returns -EBADF when a monitored slot changed during the wait. It does not report a stale positive ready count or empty ready sets.

limits: Cross-thread close/select is unspecified by Linux; EBADF is this runtime's explicit policy for the observed Windows stale-wakeup case.
No complete 16-service or client business acceptance.
